title: Scandinavian Defense: the ideas
line: Black hits White's center pawn at once, takes back with the queen, then finds her a safe square.

steps.text: White starts by pushing the pawn in front of its king two squares, into the center.
Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares. It hits White's pawn on e4 at once.

steps.after: White's knight hits your queen. This is the price of the early queen: White gains time chasing her.

steps.text: Move the queen to a5, out of the knight's reach. From there she eyes the knight on c3.

wrong.d5c6: White's bishop comes to b5 and pins the queen to your king.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out before the pawn in front of your king moves and shuts it in.
Push the pawn on e7 one square, so your other bishop can come out.
Push the pawn on c7 one square. It gives your queen a way back and keeps White's pieces off d5 and b5.
steps.after: Your pieces are out, and the queen has a square to come back to behind your pawns.

summary: The Scandinavian takes White's center pawn at once. The queen steps out of reach and the pieces come out around her.
